title: Hyperspace planner expansion
description: Stage-two planner output (BUILD.md section 9.2), filled by the local language model through Ollama's format parameter, or by the template fallback. Flat on purpose: no oneOf/anyOf/$ref, at most three levels. Content limits of section 4.3 apply to every string.

world_prompts.description: One to three image prompts for the breakthrough world backdrop, in the given world category: self-luminous, jewelled, intricate, hyper-saturated, alive, no text or letters.

world_description.description: One or two plain sentences describing the world, used by the report writer.

entities.description: One item per entity of the skeleton, in the same order.

entity_index.description: Index of the entity in the skeleton, starting at 0.

appearance.description: One sentence describing how the being looks (made of light and geometry, robed, radiant; never graphic, never suggestive, never a real person).

prompts.description: Exactly three image prompt variants of the same being on a plain dark background, no text or letters.

beats.description: Behaviour beats in order, with rough timing.

at_s.description: Seconds after the being appears, 0 to 120.

note.description: Short phrase describing what the being does in this beat.

sealed_message.description: The words behind the glyph message, shown only in the report: one or two abstract, non-directive sentences about attention, play, care, curiosity or wonder. Never an instruction, advice, prediction or real person. Empty string when the skeleton has no message.

private_summary.description: Two to four sentences for the report writer summarising world, beings and arc. Never shown during the trip.
